h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bulandshahr

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bulandshahr

c: Bulandshahr is a district town in western Uttar Pradesh, between the Ganga and the Yamuna, on the outer edge of the National Capital Region. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bulandshahr to schools, colleges, municipal and village parks, government offices and residential colonies. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away, and deliver to UP by road.

Winter is the season that most affects an open gym in this part of the Doab. From December to January, dense fog and cold mornings keep the equipment damp, and people come out later in the day. Machines that warm the body up gently get used most in these months. Summer is very hot and dry, and the monsoon brings heavy rain, so the frames are galvanised pipe and the seats and pedals are roto-moulded plastic.

items.q: Do outdoor gym machines work in foggy, cold weather?
items.a: Yes. Damp from fog does not harm galvanised frames or plastic seats. Wipe the seats before use and place the gym in morning sun so it dries quickly.

items.q: Can a village park in Bulandshahr district get an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road to towns and villages and grout the machines into concrete on open ground. Send us the ground size and a few photos.

items.q: Do the machines need any training to use?
items.a: Most need none, because they use the person's own body weight. A small instruction board beside each machine helps first-time users.
